# AMEND-R3 (harness instrument defect, logged per protocol section 5)
Defect: protocol section 2 defines P6/C4 as "decisions, attempts, observations, reconciliations unchanged" (no authorization-state write), but the harness instrument implemented a stricter rule ("no top-level store key changes except resolution_checks and input_time_floors"). First run (retained at raw/739efe7-run1-strict-instrument/) failed P6/C4 in every case because the store key `check_events` also changed. Source (bounded.py CheckEvent, "Append-only local resolution journal; no external commit assertion", appended by the same resolution step as ResolutionCheck) shows check_events is resolution journaling, not authorization state.
Fix: `unexpected` now lists changes to exactly the four lists named in the protocol; the stricter variant is retained as `strict_unexpected_keys` and `check_events_delta`/`check_event_phases` are recorded as observations. Expectation text, criteria and pass thresholds unchanged. Substantive adverse observation kept for the Architect: doc 06 section 5 names only ResolutionCheck and input-time-floor bookkeeping; the observed behavior additionally appends check_events rows (same journaling step).
